title: Barbu: Learn Card Games
shortDescription: Learn Gin Rummy, Hearts and Whist with short lessons and guided hands.
fullDescription:
Learn to play Gin Rummy, Hearts, Whist, Spades and Bridge by making card decisions, not just reading rules. Barbu offers interactive lessons, feedback and guided hands to help you feel ready for a game with friends, family or a local card club.

MAKE A CHOICE. UNDERSTAND THE PLAY.
Start with a short lesson, choose your cards and see why a move works. Follow a learning path or revisit a skill. Open Game rules whenever you need a reference.

BUILD CONFIDENCE WITH GUIDED HANDS
Put the lessons together in a full hand against computer opponents. Guided play explains decisions as you go. Practise at your own pace, then use Play for an independent game. Local saves let you return to an unfinished session.

EXPLORE THE FREE TABLES
- Gin Rummy: drawing from the stock or discard pile, building melds, reducing deadwood, knocking and going gin.
- Hearts: passing three cards, following suit, avoiding penalties and shooting the moon.
- Whist: the turned trump, partnership tricks and scoring.
- Spades: partnership bidding, nil, bags and playing to your contract.
- Bridge: introductory bidding, contracts, declarer and dummy play.
- Barbu: a seven-contract training session with different challenges, including Domino.
- Card Counting I: learning exercises for remembering played cards.

These tables and their current learning content are free, with no ads or timers. Lessons are in English. Card Counting I is a learning activity rather than a separate match mode.

OPTIONAL BARBU PREMIUM
An optional monthly or yearly subscription adds Modern American Canasta: four-player partnership games against computer opponents, eight learning topics and guided hands. Learn card values, melds, opening requirements, meld risk, taking the discard pile, discarding, going out and scoring.

Premium is not required for the free tables. Subscription availability varies by country. Google Play shows the local price and billing period before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through Google Play. Premium needs an internet connection when you reopen Barbu to verify access.

LEARN HERE. PLAY TOGETHER.
Share Barbu with a friend, or use Get out and play to open a Google Maps search for nearby card clubs. Results come from Google Maps, not a verified Barbu directory.

Barbu is single-player. It does not offer online multiplayer, club membership or tournament booking. Local groups may use different rules and bidding conventions; check with your table before playing.
